answer: Each active identity forfeits a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. The fee is charged through an umber debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the meadow totals, and the ripple anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 3 units per epoch, sustaining 395 aliases for 36 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the hostile operator. That is 8 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
